residual_risks: Database schema and unique-key definitions are absent from this delivered workspace; MySQL locking and concurrency behavior were not validated against a real database.
HarmonyOS device interactions were not exercised; a successful HAP compile does not prove navigation or notification behavior.
testing_gaps: Real database interleavings remain untested for simultaneous invitation claims, plan changes versus task generation, and confirmations versus expiry scans.
Delay and ownership tests inspect wrapper structure but do not validate bound timestamp/ownership values against stored rows.
Expiry of an existing DELAYED record still lacks a dedicated behavioral regression; repeated expiry/new UNCONFIRMED insertion is covered.
Runtime verification remains outstanding for rapid taps, concurrent expired requests, stale unauthorized responses after login, and back-stack clearing.
